blocks.text: He was singing in church at *two.* At twelve, a video of him singing Nina Simone opened a **Jay-Z** video. At seventeen he was on tour with **H.E.R.**
Then Ryan Coogler handed him a guitar — and made him the *beating heart*
of a film that set the record for Oscar nominations.
